# Questionnaire


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyjson)
library(tidyverse)


answers <- tidyjson::read_json("questionnaire.json") |>
                tidyjson::gather_object() |>
                tidyjson::enter_object(answers) |>
                tidyjson::gather_object() |>
                tidyjson::json_types() |>
                tidyjson::filter(type == "array") |>
                tidyjson::gather_array() |>
                tidyjson::append_values_string() |>
                dplyr::tibble() |>
                dplyr::transmute(variable = name, language = name.2, answer = string, index = array.index) |>
                dplyr::group_by(variable, language)  
                
questions <- tidyjson::read_json("questionnaire.json") |>
                tidyjson::gather_object() |>
                tidyjson::enter_object(question)  |>
                tidyjson::gather_object() |>
                tidyjson::json_types() |>
                tidyjson::gather_array() |>
                tidyjson::append_values_string() |>
                dplyr::tibble() |>
                dplyr::transmute(variable = name, language= name.2, question = string) |>
                dplyr::group_by(variable, language) |>
                dplyr::summarize(question = paste(question, collapse = "\n\n")) |>
                dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(variable, language, answer = question, index = 0)



data <- answers |>
  rbind(questions) |>
  arrange(variable, language, index) |>
  group_by(variable, language) |>
  mutate(question = c(answer[1], rep("", length(answer) -1 )), answer = c("", answer[-1])) %>%
  select(variable, language, question, answer) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

data_english <- data %>%
  filter(language == "english") %>%
  select(-c(variable, language)) %>%
  rename(question_en = question, answer_en = answer)

data_spanish <- data %>%
  filter(language == "spanish") %>%
  select(-c(language)) %>%
  rename(question_sp = question, answer_sp = answer)

data_final <- data_english %>% 
  cbind(data_spanish) %>%
  filter(variable != "consent")

gt::gt(data_final, groupname_col = "variable") |>
  gt::cols_label(
      question_en = "",
      answer_en = "",
      question_sp = "",
      answer_sp = ""
  ) |>
  gt::opt_horizontal_padding(scale = 3) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(size =  "large", align = "left"),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    row_group.padding = 30,
    row_group.border.top.width = 0,
    table_body.hlines.width = 0
  )
```
